frozen_design.name: D replacement-device 53005 fixed baseline and cost-transfer qualification
frozen_design.resource_policy: New-host operational reserve, explicitly replacing only this new design local threshold: 2GiB before queue and after lock before GPU initialization; 1.5GiB before each full warm/formal episode, outside the unchanged original episode clock. Preserve partial/failure status and stop on failed preflight; no automatic retry or weakened check inside a timed step. UUID/driver/lock inode checked at the same boundaries.

resource_evidence.interpretation: 500MiB raw/log exceeds 2.5 times the largest measured full group; 512MiB new cache exceeds 5 times measured current cache. Start2GiB covers those budgets plus1GiB floor. Between-episode1.5GiB retains1GiB floor plus at least500MiB remaining raw/log allowance. External changes remain possible, hence repeated checks; this is an operational budget, not a memory guarantee.
resource_evidence.history: Old frozen4GiB designs and negative initialization records remain untouched. User did not mandate a universal4GiB reserve; newer shared A/B notices used3GiB. This new-host revision is explicit and evidence-based.

frozen_design.expected_software: Parent/runtime source hashes unchanged; root separately verified Torch2.11.0, vLLM0.26, Triton3.6 and migrated model. Actual environment.json remains authoritative.
frozen_design.purpose: One baseline/cost-transfer qualification group after endpoint and physical GPU/driver replacement. OldPRO6000 GPU-94203fc3-1021-3a9c-a367-cff792479616 driver595.71.05 differs from this device. Do not assume old fitted Niyama coefficients transfer.
frozen_design.not_a_search: Fixed1024/2048 pair already chosen; no reopened cap/load search, no new controller, no extra formal attempts or automatic rerun.
frozen_design.controls: Exact unchanged parent episode and normal wall-clock arrival/add/output/full-drain loop; BF16 model, normal KV utilization0.9, total4096, maxseq192, maxcontext4096, native FCFS/admission/victims/recovery/kernels unchanged. Wrapper only validates startup/episode-boundary resources and supplements protocol metadata.
frozen_design.warmup: Original full trace once at fixed1024 and once at fixed2048 in the shared engine before four formals. Report actual coverage and any formal compilation separately; never discard failed attempts.
frozen_design.output_contract: Same256 request IDs, arrivals, prompt tokens and declared fixed min=max output counts with ignoreEOS. Counts do not establish identical content/routing/computation/quality.
frozen_design.analysis: Reuse mixed_arrivals/analyze_fixed.py with --small-cap1024 --large-cap2048 and this design. Same raw throughput, TTFT, completion flow, per-request maximum generation gap and4s/100ms/20s joint SLO with full elapsed denominator. Existing3%goodput/5%latency guard remains unchanged; device/cost transfer decision is assessed separately by root from actual new-device evidence.
frozen_design.stopping: One two-warm/four-formal group only; no command loop. Root retains all complete/partial output and failure metadata. No automatic transfer claim, retry, threshold retuning or Niyama launch from this wrapper.
frozen_design.after_lock_idle_scope: Only after common lock acquisition and parent compute-app cleanup, before GPU initialization. Require two consecutive readings <=5% utilization and <=16MiB used, separated by at least0.5s within a5s total idle-query grace. Query timeout and sleeps use remaining grace; fail RESOURCE_BLOCKED_NO_GPU_INITIALIZED if not confirmed. Never run this idle check before an episode because our own engine is then loaded. No resets, kills or concurrent-job changes.
frozen_design.operational_preupload_revision: Before any upload/submission of this group, shared B observed0MiB/no compute apps with100% GPU utilization; add the bounded after-lock idle predicate to catch that observed failure mode. Science, workload, policies, episode loop and metrics unchanged. Existing old frozen designs/history remain untouched.
frozen_design.analysis_source_scope: analysis_source_sha256 is local post-readback provenance metadata, already checked locally by root. The execution host checks only source_sha256 and workload; it need not contain or import analysis files. --check-only verifies GPU execution inputs, not local analysis dependencies or live resources.

cost_transfer_decision.scope: Every formal run and each of le512/gt512; observed actual P,D,Cd,Cp only; no SLO guarantee
cost_transfer_decision.pass: Old coefficients usable as a transfer diagnostic on these observed states, not proven valid on all candidate actions.
cost_transfer_decision.fail: Fit the same linear family on first two new-device formal runs and validate the reversed last two; CPU only, no automatic extra GPU group. Unsupported or empty regime does not pass.

scope: Two reversed pairs on one fresh development arrival, not statistical confirmation. All requests and full elapsed retained; fixed prompt/output counts are not content, routing, computation or quality equivalence. No per-window oracle or controller claim. Mixed signs remain inconclusive; a missing uniform winner alone is not evidence for dynamics.
